prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic indoor cafe or bookstore portrait with a calm contemplative mood, preserving the knit rugby-style pullover, sunglasses and modern interior geometry.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dark-brown softly wavy hair and straight fringe, natural makeup, round metal-frame sunglasses with dark lenses and a calm off-camera gaze. She wears a cream, navy and soft-grey textured knit rugby-style pullover with ribbed cuffs and supplied red chest lettering.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium close-up, subject centered slightly right and seated at a wooden table. She leans forward with one elbow on the table and chin resting on her hand. Use table edge and ceiling lines as subtle leading lines; include bookshelves or retail fixtures, track lighting and recessed lights in a softly defocused modern cafe interior.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft mixed window daylight and overhead interior lighting from the frontal side, gentle highlights on cheekbones and hair with minimal shadow falloff. Keep the mood calm, introspective, clean and slightly muted.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical portrait, standard portrait focal length, f/2–f/3.5 look, sharp face, sunglasses and knit texture, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, natural skin tones and balanced neutral color grade.
